title: cannot_verify
description: A validator cannot follow the proof. Distinct from a reject: reject means the claim is wrong, this means it cannot be judged as written. The author may answer at once — there is no waiting for a quorum of objections.

claimHash.description: Also the thread identifier. One thread per claim, so nothing extra is minted and a node can address a thread it heard about second-hand.

answering.description: The clarification sequence this objection is filed against. An objection filed before the latest clarification does not count toward the threshold — otherwise the ratio only ever climbs and one bad round of questions condemns a claim permanently.

blocker.description: out_of_reach means this validator lacks the means, not that the claim is deficient. It is excluded from the objection ratio.

detail.description: What was tried and where it stopped.
